text:
sophie: FYI — customer report: large spike -> many 5xx/gateway timeouts for hosted API across a single tenant. Looks like scale-up didn't keep up.
maria: this smells like the HPA/KEDA probe timing mismatch we saw last month. any quick repro or logs?
chen: I'm pulling the tenant's request logs now. latency/queue shows backlog before pods start. 504s spike exactly when queue depth crosses 600.
dave: sharing initial investigation: the KEDA ScaledObject metricSource is pointing at `custom-queue-metrics` but metrics show a delay in scraping. possible scrape interval misconfig.
ops-bot: alert: high-5xx-rate for tenant-id=tn-483, gateway-504-rate=72/min, avg-queue-depth=812
sophie: can you paste the KEDA ScaledObject and HPA config? also which prewarm/warmup hooks we have for the model runtime?
chen: config snippets:
```
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: tenant-tn-483-scaledobj
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: runtime-dep
  pollingInterval: 30
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://prometheus:9090
      metricName: queue_depth
      threshold: '400'
```
and HPA minReplicas=0, targetCPU=70
maria: pollingInterval=30 is high for bursty queues. probe scraping can be delayed if prometheus scrape interval is 15s and the metric aggregation adds latency.
dave: also saw model container init takes ~22s for quantized weights load on g4dn nodes; with minReplicas=0 that adds a big hit.
sophie: so root cause likely twofold: metric source delay (KEDA reacts late) + coldstart model warmup time > gateway timeout window.
support-oncall: customer-facing note: apologizing, we've identified autoscale lag causing timeouts. ops team working on mitigations now.
chen: repro steps I ran:
1) throttle steady baseline at 50 rps
2) inject 700 rps for 25s
3) observe KEDA metric crosses threshold but new pods appear 45-60s later
4) gateway responds 504s in the gap
logs:
```
[2026-03-09T14:02:12Z] scaler: observed queue_depth=420 (threshold 400)
[2026-03-09T14:02:45Z] orchestrator: creating pod runtime-dep-xyz
[2026-03-09T14:03:08Z] runtime-dep-xyz: model init complete, kv cache primed
[2026-03-09T14:03:12Z] gateway: responded 504 -> upstream timeout
```
maria: mitigation options:
- reduce KEDA pollingInterval to 5s for bursty tenants (per-tenant override)
- set HPA minReplicas to 1 for >X qps tenants
- enable a lightweight prewarm image that boots in <3s to hold sockets
- shorten gateway upstream timeout slightly and add fallback model variant
dave: quick patch I'm pushing: set pollingInterval to 5 for this scaledobject and add annotation keda.sh/activationThreshold=200
sophie: roll it carefully — changing polling globally is risky. do per-tenant annotation + a policy rule in the provisioner.
support-oncall: I'll update the customer: patch applied to their scaledobject, setting pollingInterval=5 and minReplicas=1 temporarily. ETA to stabilize ~3-5 mins.
ops-bot: deploy: scaledobject/tenant-tn-483-scaledobj patched by dave @ 1748203120
chen: after patch, observed pods spin up within ~12s and 504s dropped to near-zero for the burst tests. queue depth still spikes but handled.
sophie: follow-up items:
- engineering: evaluate model warmup optimization (parallel quant block load) — owner: chen, due EOW
- platform: add per-tenant scale policy for customers with >200 qps — owner: dave, due next sprint
- support: update runbook on scale-up lag + suggested temporary mitigations (minReplicas, pollingInterval) — owner: maria, due today
maria: adding runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/scaleup-lag
support-oncall: customer updated and will accept a follow-up architecture review. thanks team :thumbsup:
sophie: closing thread in 24h if no regressions. Great triage.
